title: OTHRYS OS Housekeeping and Mnemosyne estate consolidation
goal: Define the current OTHRYS OS house from live repo truth, centralize and index its existing knowledge estate in Mnemosyne, recover proven legacy Mnemosyne quality controls, and verify the house repeatedly without adding product capability.

work.problem: OTHRYS OS now has a working structural foundation, but its books, logs, evidence and legacy knowledge are spread across many repositories and worktrees instead of one inspectable Mnemosyne estate.
out_of_scope: No UI expansion or visual refinement
No new Titan, Muse or Greek subsystem
No autonomous promotion or canon mutation
No vector database or new model dependency
risks: Secrets are copied into the knowledge archive
Historical evidence is summarized away instead of preserved
Books become aspirational instead of repo-grounded

laws: The live repositories are the quarry; chat memory is non-authoritative.
Every archived source is byte-preserved and SHA-256 addressed.
Duplicate content across worktrees is one knowledge object with many provenance refs.
Secret-shaped source bytes are excluded and recorded by pattern name only.
Mnemosyne remains the knowledge authority; Atlas remains a derived read model.
Books describe only proven current house surfaces and cite their source evidence.
No housekeeping change may grant execution authority or relax Trust Canal/Talos gates.
Tests must become boring: repeat cleanly, detect drift, and fail closed.

slices.title: Define the OTHRYS OS house and Book shelf

tasks.title: Map only existing authorities, systems, stores, interfaces and projects
Define one Book of obligation for every admitted house surface
Reject duplicate names and duplicate architectural roles
Verify every house claim against current repo evidence

slices.title: Centralize logs, evidence, books and documents in Mnemosyne

tasks.title: Inventory every Git workspace and collapse worktree lineages
Hash every knowledge-bearing text source and deduplicate by content
Copy safe unique source bytes into the content-addressed Mnemosyne archive
Verify archive digest, provenance completeness, duplicate collapse and secret exclusions

slices.title: Recover proven Mnemosyne quality controls without widening authority

tasks.title: Reuse structured provenance, contradiction and leak-screen law
Reuse deterministic snapshot/integrity concepts where compatible with explicit-file V2 law
Run the complete cross-language V2 runtime repeatedly
Run Book/catalogue/house drift checks and record every remaining defect
